goal: Normalize the public CGNK release identity, bind history audits to an explicit Source Closure, and use the ITER-056 paired oracle as an anti-overengineering gate before any architecture admission Router implementation.
acceptance_criteria: public branding consistently uses CGNK while the cgkn Python namespace and legacy machine identifiers remain compatible
history audit reports the exact scope commit, unique reachable blob count, policy, and result hash
main advances from the validated release lineage without force push or history rewrite and becomes the GitHub default branch
the ITER-056 B0/B4 paired oracle is reproduced before any Router implementation
Router V1 is implemented only if the frozen opportunity gate authorizes it
full repository regression finishes with zero failures and zero errors before release

quality_metrics.measure: oracle gain over Always Direct Cheap

prevention: do not rename the Python package
control: no Router after a failed opportunity gate
improvement: keep architecture opt-in only when evidence supports it

interface_expectations: CGNK is the public name and cgkn remains the compatibility package namespace
legacy CGKN schema kinds remain stable machine identifiers
an admission policy, if authorized, may choose an execution level but cannot plan or change business behavior
CapabilityTree, ExecutionDAG, Knowledge, Registry, Runtime, State, and public-delivery authorities remain unchanged
